profile.headline: Software Engineer at QVI International
profile.summary: Senior level Software Engineer with expertise in software analysis and design of creative, optimal solutions across the full life cycle.  Background ranges from design and development of automated test-bed systems and new product software to embedded product firmware.  Expert in User Interface design and rapid prototyping.  Proven track record of designing and implementing flexible solutions, which support frequent UI and functionality changes.  Excellent communicator at all levels of the organization, including customer, client and vendor relationships.  Outstanding verbal and graphic presentation skills.  Exceptional mechanical aptitude.  Co-inventor of several U.S. patents.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Develop software, especially User Interface software, for new products.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer for Research and Development
positions.description:
Investigated new technologies in advanced imaging systems, printing systems and RFID technologies.
Designed, developed, and implemented innovative software and hardware systems to support research projects.  

Accomplishments:

• Developed embedded UI code for new color printer product line.

• Designed, developed and implemented sophisticated software/hardware systems to characterize state-of-the-art LCD imaging devices for potential integration into new and existing product lines.  

• Traveled to Japan as corporate technical representative to evaluate potential business relationship with major Japanese corporation.

• Selected as corporate technical representative to manage 5-year relationship with California based manufacturer of digital LCD imaging devices.  Designed and implemented numerous SW/HW tests to evaluate LCD imager characteristics, enabling the manufacturer to make improvements to their fabrication procedure, allowing Kodak to use device in printing applications.

• Designed, developed and implemented full software package to integrate state-of-the-art imaging device into a digital print engine.  

• Integrated digital print engine into optical mini-lab to demonstrate capabilities to management, which led to approved funding for commercialization.

• Designed and developed full SW/HW system to drive a 5’ by 10’ computer display wall for Radiological Society of North America’s largest trade show.

• Designed, developed and documented full software package for aerial color film processor for military use.

• Designed and developed SW/HW system to fully automate characterization of thin-film sonar transducer.

• Developed data acquisition, control and analysis software for high-density recording systems used in DOD facilities.

• Traveled extensively to secured customer sites to perform analysis of requirements, contract negotiation, installation, maintenance and training.
